public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Wayve, a Series D AI & Software company founded by Amar Shah and Alex Kendall, commands a current post-money valuation of $8.6B on $1.5B raised to date. The peer comparison universe comprises one public company (Palantir, PLTR) and eight private frontier-tech firms across AI & Software, including Figure AI, Waymo, Scale AI, and others at Series C through Series E stages.

Two valuation methods anchor the analysis. Stage-progression modeling, applying a typical 1.5x multiplier to the $8.6B Series D post-money, yields $12.9B. Peer-median triangulation across five same-sector and same/adjacent-stage comparables (Figure AI at $39.0B, Skild AI at $14.0B, Crusoe Energy at $10.0B, SandboxAQ at $5.8B, and Ayar Labs at $3.8B) produces a $10.0B median, with a range spanning $3.8B to $39.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous market positions and capital deployment timelines within frontier AI.

The triangulated range supports a valuation of $8.5B to $14.8B, with a median point of $11.4B. The current $8.6B valuation sits at the lower bound, consistent with recent post-money marks. Key uncertainties include capital efficiency relative to peers, pathway to revenue monetization, and near-term funding environment sentiment, which materially influence stage-progression step-up assumptions and peer relevance weighting.
